title: Accu-Chek Insight: TemporaryBasal sync crashes in InsightPlugin.readHistory() / SyncPumpTemporaryBasalTransaction setEnd()
body:
Running Boost-in-AAPS_3.4 / AAPS 3.4.2.1 with an Accu-Chek Insight Bluetooth pump, Insight pump-history processing repeatedly fails while syncing a `TemporaryBasal`:

```text
java.lang.IllegalArgumentException: Failed requirement.
    at app.aaps.database.entities.interfaces.DBEntryWithTimeAndDurationKt.setEnd(DBEntryWithTimeAndDuration.kt:11)
    at app.aaps.database.transactions.SyncPumpTemporaryBasalTransaction.run$impl_fullRelease(SyncPumpTemporaryBasalTransaction.kt:39)
```

### AI assumptions

The immediate failure seems in the shared database transaction, not in Boost dosing logic. `SyncPumpTemporaryBasalTransaction` tries to close an already-running TBR with:

```kotlin
running.end = temporaryBasal.timestamp
```

`DBEntryWithTimeAndDuration.end` computes:

```kotlin
duration = value - timestamp
require(duration > 0)
```

So the crash means the transaction attempted to set an end time that produced a **zero or negative duration**. Given the DAO query used by this transaction, the most likely concrete case is **zero duration caused by a same-start TBR duplicate**:

```text
running.timestamp == incomingTemporaryBasal.timestamp
```

### Environment

| Field | Value from log / DeviceStatus |
|---|---|
| AAPS build | `3.4.2.1-0725f9e312-2026.04.18` |
| Boost build | `Boost v4.1.5 (Kotlin)` |
| Device | Google Pixel 9a |
| Pump type | `ACCU_CHEK_INSIGHT_BLUETOOTH` |

The same DB / `readHistory()` failure pair appears four times in about 13 minutes:

### Possibly related AndroidAPS issues 
#4029 Near-identical `Error while syncing TemporaryBasal` / `setEnd` stacktrace. Reporter later attributed it to one offending TBR in pump history that aged out after about 24 hours.

### Follow up

I created a branch with extra logging https://github.com/PieterGit/Boost-in-AAPS_3.4/tree/dev_logging_tbr with a bit of help of Claude AI and OpenAI ChatGPT. That is based on https://github.com/PieterGit/Boost-in-AAPS_3.4/commit/0725f9e312003f45fa93d172a57f35273d947d49 (current dev and master of Boost 3.4). This adds more logging so see what can be wrong with the pump history.

I completely reinstalled the app and fixed a problem with the app directory and since then the problem has not occured again. I will monitor logs closely. This problem or the problem with the app directory (why I couldn't export preferences or logs) caused about 40% of the battery usage for AAPS app and it somehow created a lot of app/pump traffic, also impacting looping.

I will monitor logs closely in the coming days and weeks. I think issue can then be closed if nobody else experiences it and it cannot be reproduced.
